description: This file defines the AccessFlowStateMachineDao class, which manages database interactions related to workflow state transitions in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to query, save, delete, and verify workflow state machine records.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing WorkflowStateMachine entities, providing query, existence check, save, delete, and update operations.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves allowed actions for a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Retrieves workflow items for a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Fetches the next state in the workflow for a given current state, role, and action.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Retrieves states where specific actions are actionable for a given workflow and role.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a new WorkflowStateMachine record to the database.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists multiple WorkflowStateMachine records at once.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on parameters.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes workflow records associated with a specific user role, optionally filtered by workflow.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates role names in workflow records during a role rename operation.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Retrieves all allowed recruitment application states for a given workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all workflow state machine records for a given workflow and optionally a role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is permitted in the current workflow state for a role.

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkflowStateMachine record by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Fetches a workflow state machine record matching specific workflow, state, action, and role.
